messages:
mike: Heads-up: running through the new Next.js + LlamaIndex starter and hit a weird auth/retry UX. Notebook cell streams tokens then stalls and retries forever.
anya: which starter branch + sdk version?
mike: devex-starters main, requirements pin shows redwood-sdk==0.8.0 and llama-index 0.9.x. Repro: open notebooks/interactive.ipynb -> run `summarize_long_doc` cell (it streams ~90s). After ~70s it logs 401 then SDK retries and we see 429s. Cell never surfaces a clear error.
frank: can you paste the snippet and the proxied logs?
mike: snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(os.environ.get("REDWOOD_DEMO_TOKEN"))
index = LlamaIndex.from_documents(docs, client=client)
resp = index.query("Summarize...", streaming=True)
```
logs (sanitized):
[2025-06-02T12:04:10Z] POST /v1/streams 200 stream-start
[2025-06-02T12:05:12Z] STREAM ERROR: 401 Unauthorized (token expired)
[2025-06-02T12:05:12Z] SDK RETRY attempt=1 after 401
[2025-06-02T12:05:13Z] POST /v1/streams 429 Too Many Requests
[2025-06-02T12:05:23Z] SDK BACKOFF 10s
...repeat...
Error seen in notebook UI: "Stream connection closed unexpectedly" then cell spinner hangs.
anya: Ack. This is the parity gap: JS added a guard last quarter to abort retries when a 401 occurs mid-stream, so users get a clear auth error. Python still retries and causes cascading 429s.
frank: short-term mitigation: update the starter README to recommend using REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN (longer TTL) for interactive notebooks and add a preflight TTL check cell that warns if TTL < 120s.
mike: I'm happy to open that PR, but also think the SDK should default to not retry on 401 for active streams. We should also expose an opt-in flag to preserve old behavior for servers.
anya: agreed. Can we add an eval harness that simulates token expiry mid-stream and asserts SDK surfaces AuthenticationError instead of retry loops? That would prevent regressions in CI.
frank: yes I'll add a harness under eng-ml/evals/stream-auth-expiry using a fake token TTL and a mocked SSE server.
docs-bot: NOTE added to starter README: "For interactive notebooks use a longer-lived dev token (REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN) or run the preflight TTL check cell to avoid mid-stream auth expiries."
ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-starters/pull/311 (README + preflight + bump sdk to 0.8.2-rc). Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/devex-starters/pr-311
mike: verified PR locally. With the preflight cell the notebook warns and stops before streaming when TTL < 120s, much better UX. Confirmed when using a long-lived token the stream completes.
anya: SDK owners: please backport the JS 401-midstream guard to Python stable and add a telemetry event when we abort a stream due to auth so we can surface workshop pain. Also add a config param `retry_on_401_for_streams` default false for interactive clients.
frank: noted. I'll file SDK ISSUE-311 and assign. Also will add the eval harness test to nightly.
mike: thanks all — leaving a short inline comment in the notebook with guidance for workshop attendees. :thumbsup:
